title: HARP agent_auth Metadata Block
description: The agent_auth metadata block carried in OAuth authorization-server metadata. Holds the base auth.md registration fields plus the HARP healthcare extension under the harp key.

agent_auth.description: Registration metadata an agent reads to discover endpoints, supported identity types, and the HARP healthcare extension.

identity_endpoint.description: Endpoint where an agent posts an identity request to register.

claim_endpoint.description: Endpoint where a human claims an agent-created account.

events_endpoint.description: Endpoint that receives registration-layer security event notifications.

identity_types_supported.description: Identity request types this service accepts.

assertion_types_supported.description: Assertion token types accepted, for example the ID-JAG token type URN.

events_supported.description: Security event types this service can emit or receive.

harp.description: HARP healthcare extension. Present when the service offers the purpose-bound, PHI-aware path.

version.description: HARP profile version this block conforms to.

baa.description: Business Associate Agreement terms and acceptance endpoint.

required_for_phi.description: True if a completed BAA acceptance is required before any PHI scope is issued.

terms_uri.description: URL of the human-readable BAA terms.

accept_endpoint.description: Endpoint where the controlling organization accepts the BAA programmatically.

version_hash.description: Content hash of the BAA terms, for example sha256:...

identity_proofing.description: NIST SP 800-63 identity assurance and authenticator assurance levels required per scope tier.

autonomy.description: What the service does without a human and what it gates behind human review.

auto.description: Scopes or actions the service performs autonomously.

human_review_required.description: Actions that always require a human reviewer.

note.description: Free-text note on the autonomy policy.

delegation.description: How the service carries the delegation chain from organization to agent.

chain_required.description: True if a full delegation chain must be present on each token.

claims.description: Token claims used to carry delegation, for example act.

format.description: Delegation format, for example rfc8693 token exchange.

payment_mandates_supported.description: Agent payment mandate protocols the service accepts.

supported.description: True if the service emits signed receipts for consequential actions.

format_uri.description: URL of the receipt format definition.

verify_uri.description: Endpoint where a third party can verify a receipt.

free_tier.description: What an unclaimed or anonymous agent can do with no contract and no PHI.

scopes.description: Scopes available on the free tier.

data.description: Data class available on the free tier, for example synthetic_or_deidentified.

rate_limit.description: Rate limit applied to the free tier, for example 100/day.

assuranceLevel.description: A pair of NIST SP 800-63 assurance levels: ial (identity) and aal (authenticator).
